_comment: Phase-2c eyeball / diagnostic prompt set. Each entry pairs a native-JA prompt with the EN translation the teacher arm (ja_t5en) puts on its T5 side, so `en` must be a faithful translation, not a paraphrase. Five registers, deliberately mixed: t* = danbooru tag-style (the training register), s* = sentence prose (D2/D7 register, untrained), q* = embedded quoted text (D6, eval-only by design), n* = proper nouns (risk 4: raw MT transliterates these, so the rows may be unvisited), c* = composition/lighting vocabulary. Consumed by bench/cjk_adapter/run_bench.py --prompts. Tag-style prompts join with ", " (the primary student joiner since 2026-08-30); prose prompts keep 、 as punctuation.
